description: This file defines an entity decorator class 'InterviewAttachmentDecorator' for the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It provides methods to manipulate and retrieve contents of interview attachment entities, including streaming file content and associating interviews by ID.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for InterviewAttachment entity providing additional functionalities such as retrieving file content and associating with interviews via ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an InterviewAttachment entity.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the file content from the attached InterviewAttachment, converting resource streams to string if necessary.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachment
methods.description: Protected method to access the underlying InterviewAttachment entity.

methods.name: setInterviewById
methods.description: Associates an Interview entity with the attachment using its ID.
